data.narrative:
Radian Aerospace is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation landscape for this sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers such as SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though a tight cohort of same-stage direct comparables is unavailable.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the company's $27.5M in total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression in venture markets, yielding an implied valuation of $69M. Peer-Median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the Space & Aerospace sector (fewer than three datapoints met filtering criteria). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be performed because Radian's revenue is not disclosed, precluding application of the sector's 23.9x median Price-to-Sales multiple across the five public tickers identified.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $58M to $79M, with a median of $69M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the Stage-Progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable Seed-stage peers, undisclosed financial metrics, and the stage-multiplier assumption's applicability to this particular subsector. Revenue disclosure or additional comparable transaction data would materially strengthen conviction in this valuation.
